description: This file defines a class 'ChiSquared' in the namespace 'PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Statistical\Distributions'. It provides static methods to compute probabilities, inverse functions, and chi-squared test related calculations for the chi-squared distribution, including right-tail, left-tail, inverse, and test statistics. It also contains internal implementations for the incomplete gamma function and related numerical methods.

classes.name: ChiSquared
classes.description: Provides methods for chi-squared distribution calculations including probabilities, inverse calculations, and statistical testing.

methods.name: distributionRightTail
methods.description: Calculates the right-tailed probability for the chi-squared distribution given a value and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: distributionLeftTail
methods.description: Calculates the left-tailed probability or cumulative distribution function for the chi-squared distribution, based on input parameters.

methods.name: inverseRightTail
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the right-tailed chi-squared distribution probability, i.e., chi-squared value for a given tail probability.

methods.name: inverseLeftTail
methods.description: Computes the inverse for the left-tailed chi-squared distribution probability.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs the chi-square test for independence between observed and expected frequencies.
